name: Playlist
descriptor: An explicit order, the position of each item, and the running time to reach the end.
verify_checks: sequence: the running total is emitted
pros: an explicit order field survives edits, unlike the record order
the position and the time remaining answer the only two questions a queue raises
the total is derived, so it is right after every edit
it is the same rows as any list, so search and export still work
cons: the order is a number you type: no drag and drop
gaps in the order are tolerated, not tidied
no shuffle, no repeat, no playback
one duration per item, no chapters
best_for: a queue you decide once and then follow
avoid_if: the order must be rearranged by hand often
